name: Levoča (Slovakia)
description: Six equal horizontal stripes of white, red, white, red, white and red, ending at the fly in a swallowtail whose notch reaches one third of the flag's length.
history: The flag's colours are taken from the municipal arms, as required for Slovak municipal symbols; arms and flag are registered in the Heraldic Register of the Slovak Republic under signature L-3/91.
